title: Band breaks up; playing with the Black Eagle band
summary: The original players leave one by one, so he joins a band across the river, then is sent for to join a band in New Orleans.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings
